metadata.summary: England head coach Brian McDermott has made one change to his 19-man squad for Saturday's Rugby League World Cup match against France.
metadata.content: Rugby League World Cup: Mikey Lewis on bench as England squad named for clash vs France after opening defeat | Rugby League News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Update Rugby League World Cup: Mikey Lewis on bench as England squad named for clash vs France after opening defeat England take on France in Perth on Saturday (7.35am kick-off BST) for second Rugby League World Cup fixture, having been thrashed by Tonga in opener; England play Papua New Guinea in Wollongong on October 30; England Women began their campaign with big win vs Wales in Perth Friday 23 October 2026 10:42, UK Image: Mikey Lewis has made the England bench for the first time in the tournament England head coach Brian McDermott has made one change to his 19-man squad for Saturday's Rugby League World Cup match against France. AJ Brimson retains the job at full-back with Jack Welsby again named as an interchange, while Luke Thompson starts at prop in the absence of Morgan Knowles, who suffered an injury in the lead-up to the opening-game defeat to Tonga. Veteran centre Kallum Watkins is listed among the reserves as he chases a cap at his fourth World Cup, while Mikey Lewis returns to the bench after missing out on a place in the squad last time out. As per World Cup rules, each side is able to name a six-player bench in each game, but only four of the six players named can be brought on. metadata.content: Martin O'Neill challenges Celtic to 'find a way' in Europe - but are they just not good enough? | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Martin O'Neill challenges Celtic to 'find a way' in Europe - but are they just not good enough? The 2-1 defeat to Celta Vigo was Celtic's third straight loss in the Europa League; they are second bottom of the table and yet to pick up a point; watch Hibernian vs Celtic live on Sky Sports Football on Sunday from 11am Friday 23 October 2026 10:33, UK Image: Celtic have lost their last four games in European competition Martin O'Neill wants Celtic to find a way to win in Europe, but after a third straight defeat is the step up from domestic dominance too big for them? The Hoops are now 35th of 36 teams in the Europa League after a third loss, this time against Celta Vigo. Only Ararat-Armenia are keeping them off the bottom of the table on goal difference. A 7-1 hammering of Hearts in the Premiership gave some hope that Celtic were on the up. Instead, their European frailties were laid bare once again. messages.text: 'He wants to play a full schedule' - when will Tiger play next?

metadata.summary: Tiger Woods is hoping to play a full TGL schedule this season and could return to competitive action before the end of 2026, according to former team-mate Kevin Kisner.
metadata.content: When will Tiger Woods play next? Former TGL team-mate offers hints on Jupiter Links GC return and possible comeback date | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to main content When will Tiger Woods play next? Former TGL team-mate offers hints on Jupiter Links GC return and possible comeback date Tiger Woods is expected to feature more on the TGL this season as he continues to recover from injury; Ex-Jupiter Links GC team-mate Kevin Kisner discussed Woods' schedule plans and possible events for him to return to PGA Tour action Friday 23 October 2026 13:44, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Tiger Woods has returned to the range - and showed his confidence in how his game is progressing ahead of the Nexus Cup in September (Credit: @Tisha_Alyn) Tiger Woods is hoping to play a full TGL schedule this season and could return to competitive action before the end of 2026, according to former team-mate Kevin Kisner. Woods has not appeared on the PGA Tour since missing the cut at The Open in July 2024, with the 15-time major champion also only making one appearance in the TGL - a tech-infused indoor golf league - last season due to injury. The former world No 1 has yet to publicly announce a return to action, having been suspended from driving for five years in September after entering a plea agreement to a reckless driving charge for March's car crash.
